bio.text: Gerald Hocker has represented the 20th District in the Delaware Senate since 2012 and has been Senate Minority Leader since 2018.
Before that he served in the Delaware House of Representatives from 2002 to 2012.
Born and raised in Sussex County, Hocker owns and operates businesses in the Clarksville, Ocean View and Bethany Beach area with his wife, Emily.
Hocker graduated from Lord Baltimore High School in 1966 and holds a Bachelor of Science in business administration from the University of Delaware.
